message.content: Gavriel mentions "The Witcher 3" as a game that excels in its characters and plot twists. He highlights how the character development in the game feels very real, especially with Geralt, and how the quests and side stories are rich and engaging. Additionally, he appreciates the Gwent mini-game, which adds an extra layer of fun to the gameplay. The complexity and depth of the main storyline, coupled with the variety of plot twists, make "The Witcher 3" a standout title for Gavriel.
